stories.title: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
stories.summary: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her lifelong defense of human rights and international law.

stories.title: How the beverage aisle got so wild
stories.summary: Planet Money traced many new beverage flavors to one laboratory that serves dozens of companies to see how new flavors are created and why we're seeing such an explosion of options right now.

stories.title: Major Hurricane Isaias takes aim on Gulf Coast
stories.summary: Hurricane Isaias in poised to make landfall on the Gulf Coast near the Alabama-Florida boarder. It will be the first hurricane to make landfall in the U.S. since 2024.

stories.title: Taylor Swift is back at No. 1 on the charts
stories.summary: New songs added to her 2025 album The Life of a Showgirl has shot the release up the charts.

stories.title: ICE shooting in NYC fuels tension between New York officials and Trump administration
stories.summary: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement shot a man in New York City. It raised tensions between the Trump administration and New York officials over the state's sanctuary policies.

stories.title: Twin Temple says blending Satanic lyrics and doo-wop 'transcends what's expected'
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with the "Satanic doo-wop" duo Twin Temple about their new album Doomed Lovers and what drew them to Satanism and the occult.
